recent_articles.title: Rest still a favour, not a right, for retail-staff in Chennai - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kajal**, **Mahe**, **Meena**, and **Yasmin** all work long hours in retail stores across Chennai, but many lack proper seating arrangements despite a 2021 amendment to the Shops and Establishments Act.  While some establishments provide limited seating options, others neglect this legal provision entirely, forcing employees like **John** from Manipur and those at the Express Avenue mall to stand for extended periods. Despite the law requiring employers to provide suitable seating for employees, many retail workers continue to experience discomfort and pain due to long hours of standing without adequate rest opportunities.  The lack of enforcement and support from labor inspectors has left these workers struggling to meet their basic needs.

recent_articles.title: Astronomers identify ‘Loktak protocluster’ in the early universe named after Loktak lake in Manipur | - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Astronomers** have discovered a protocluster, known as the Loktak Protocluster, that formed only 1.2 billion years after the Big Bang. This early structure suggests that environmental influence on galaxy evolution began much earlier than previously thought. The protocluster's galaxies exhibited differences in size and star formation compared to those found in less dense environments.  The findings were made possible by observations from the Subaru Telescope and the James Webb Space Telescope.

recent_articles.title: 60 armoured units among 477 new vehicles added to Manipur police fleet - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh** and **State Home Minister Govindas Khothoujam** participated in the launch of a new fleet of armored vehicles for the **Manipur Police**. The 477 vehicles, including bulletproof Rakshak vehicles, mine-protected vehicles, and heavy machine repair vehicles, are part of the Assistance to States for Modernisation of Police scheme.  The Chief Minister emphasized the importance of strengthening police infrastructure for maintaining peace and security in the state, while the State Home Minister highlighted Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Union Home Minister Amit Shah's commitment to improving police forces nationwide.

recent_articles.title: Assam Rifles apprehend key accused in 2023 abduction-murder of two Meitei students - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Assam Rifles** apprehended **Nokjaging Baite Kuki**, a key member of the **United Kuki National Army (UKNA)**, wanted for the alleged abduction and murder of two Meitei students in July 2023.  The accused was found with an AK rifle, pistols, and grenades, and has been handed over to the **Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI)** which is probing the case. The arrest follows a series of protests sparked by the discovery of the students' bodies in September 2023.  **Lt Jamkhogin Guite**, another UKNA member, was apprehended earlier for his involvement in multiple violent incidents including attacks on government officials and civilians.

recent_articles.title: Manipur CM assures NIA probe into abduction of Naga men - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Yumnam Khemchand Singh**, the Chief Minister of Manipur, promised an investigation by the **NIA** into the alleged abduction of six Naga men. The **Kuki Inpi Manipur** extended its shutdown for another 48 hours to pressure the government for the release of 14 Kuki people, including three minors.  The **UNC**, led by Ng. Lorho, urged the government to intensify efforts to find the missing villagers. The Chief Minister also assured the delegation that the abduction case would be handed over to the **NIA** and search-and-rescue operations were underway.

recent_articles.title: Manipur DGP moved to Cabinet Secretariat - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rajiv Singh**, a 1993 batch Indian Police Service (IPS) officer of Tripura cadre, has been appointed Secretary (Security) in the **Cabinet Secretariat**.  He was appointed as Manipur's police chief in June 2023 following ethnic violence between the Meitei and Kuki-Zo people. The **Appointments Committee of the Cabinet** approved his appointment on Thursday, May 21, 2026. Singh oversaw the recovery of over 4,500 weapons looted from police armouries after the May 2023 violence and led efforts to arrest around 1,000 extortionists during Manipur's state of President's Rule.

recent_articles.title: Efforts on to release Kuki, Naga people held hostage in Manipur, say Ministers - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following the killings of four church leaders in separate ambushes, **Govindas Konthoujam**, **Losii Dikho** and other officials confirmed that at least 38 people from the Kuki and Naga communities are being held hostage by various groups.  The attacks occurred in the Kuki-dominated Kangpokpi district and the Naga-majority Noney district. The Deputy Chief Minister stated that talks were ongoing with both Kuki and Naga groups, but no resolution was reached. **Angomcha Bimol Akoijam**, a Manipur Congress MP, criticized the government's handling of the situation.  The United Naga Council (UNC) issued an ultimatum to the state government demanding the release of 20 hostages held by Kuki groups.

recent_articles.title: Netanyahu visited UAE in ‘secret’ during US-Israel war on Iran, office says | US-Israel war on Iran News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Benjamin Netanyahu**, the Israeli Prime Minister, made a secret visit to the United Arab Emirates (UAE) to meet with President **Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan**.  His office described the trip as a “historic breakthrough” in relations between Israel and the UAE. The announcement comes amid expanding cooperation between the two countries, particularly on security issues related to Iran, following Iranian attacks on the UAE in May. **Mike Huckabee**, the US Ambassador to Israel, has praised the UAE's role in bolstering Israeli-Gulf relations.  The visit follows the signing of the Abraham Accords in 2020, which normalized ties between Israel and several Arab states.

recent_articles.title: ECI set to roll out phase III of SIR in ‘coming days’ to cover 22 States, UTs - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Election Commission of India (ECI)** is set to begin phase three of its Special Intensive Revision (SIR) voter list process in the coming days, covering nearly 40 crore electors across 17 states and five UTs.  This follows completion of SIR in 10 states and three UTs previously, which has successfully removed over 60 lakh deceased voters from the rolls. The ECI had initially delayed the rollout due to Assembly elections in several states but is now proceeding with the revision process.  The exercise aims to ensure accurate voter lists for upcoming elections.

recent_articles.title: Governor’s role in government formation | Explained - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK)** secured a majority in the recent Tamil Nadu Assembly elections, but the Governor invited the party's chief to form the government.  **C. Joseph Vijay**, the TVK leader, was sworn in as Chief Minister after securing letters of support from 120 members. The Governor's discretion in appointing the Chief Minister is based on constitutional provisions and previous recommendations by commissions, but there have been instances where Governors have appointed a Chief Minister without following these guidelines.  The Supreme Court has emphasized that the "floor of the House" is the appropriate forum to determine majority support for a government.

recent_articles.title: Firearm, ammunition seized in Manipur; one arrested - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Security forces** in Manipur arrested a person from Churachandpur district after seizing a 9mm pistol, ammunition, and other weapons. **Former Chief Minister N. Biren Singh** condemned the arrest of an active Kuki National Army (Burma) cadre as a serious matter that cannot be ignored, while the **Assam Rifles** reported responding to attacks on three Naga villages in Kamjong district by apprehending an armed man with an AK-47 rifle and ammunition.

recent_articles.title: Assam Rifles rescues abducted Manipur woman from Myanmar extremist group - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Assam Rifles** personnel successfully secured the release of a Manipur woman, Olina Ningshen, who was abducted by members of the **Kuki National Army-Burma (KNA-B)** and Village Volunteers Eastern Zone during an attack on Tangkhul Naga villages in Kamjong district. The release occurred at a location south of Z. Choro village under the watch of **Assam Rifles**, intelligence, and other agencies.  The woman's family, civil society organizations, and local villagers were present during the release and provided with medical and psychological assistance.

recent_articles.title: Modi’s party poised for big wins in Indian state elections | Elections News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Narendra Modi’s** Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) is expected to win two of four crucial state elections in India, strengthening its position and weakening key rival **Mamata Banerjee**.  The BJP's lead in West Bengal and Assam suggests a significant boost for Modi as he seeks to tackle economic challenges. Opposition parties like the Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK) and All India Trinamool Congress (TMC) are facing setbacks, potentially weakening their opposition against Modi in future elections. The results of these state elections will have long-lasting implications for Indian politics, with analysts predicting a significant shift in power dynamics.

recent_articles.title: Oil prices flat as Trump’s plan for Strait of Hormuz fails to calm market | US-Israel war on Iran News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Oil prices remained largely unchanged on Monday following **President Donald Trump’s** announcement of a plan to guide vessels out of the Strait of Hormuz.  While **US Central Command** stated it would support vessels seeking to transit the waterway, senior Iranian officials have warned against any “American interference” in the strait, casting uncertainty over the fragile ceasefire between the sides. Despite **Trump’s** plan and efforts by the **United Kingdom’s military**, maritime traffic in the Strait of Hormuz remains significantly reduced due to ongoing threats from **Iran**.  Analysts suggest oil prices may remain elevated for some time after any peace deal is reached, as a backlog of unloaded energy supplies and damaged infrastructure persist.

recent_articles.title: Security forces destroy 23 illegal bunkers, seize 18 IEDs in Manipur - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Security forces** in Manipur have conducted two separate operations, destroying 23 bunkers and seizing weapons and explosives. The first operation targeted illegal bunkers in Ukhrul district, resulting in the seizure of a pump action gun, ammunition, and IEDs. A second operation in Tengnoupal district led to the destruction of an IED cache and the recovery of firearms and ammunition. These operations follow violence between Tangkhul Naga and Kuki communities that has resulted in casualties and property damage since February.

recent_articles.title: First talks under new Manipur government held with Kuki-Zo insurgent groups - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Union Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA)** and the **Manipur government** resumed talks with Kuki-Zo insurgent groups who are in a suspension of operations (SoO) pact with the government. The dialogue, which marked the first meeting since an elected government under Chief Minister Y. Khemchand Singh was restored on February 4, is significant.

recent_articles.title: Supreme Court asks petitioner to turn in first-generation copy of leaked Manipur audio to forensic lab - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Supreme Court of India** ordered the **Kuki Organisation for Human Rights** to provide the first generation copy of leaked audio tapes allegedly implicating former Manipur Chief Minister N. Biren Singh in the 2023-2024 ethnic violence to the national forensic lab. The court stated that further copies would diminish the evidence's authenticity and requested the NGO to locate the original recording device, as it could reveal the whistleblower's identity.  The forensic lab will require six weeks to analyze the tapes and prepare a report.

recent_articles.title: Amid fresh unrest, Home Secretary reviews Manipur security situation - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Union Home Secretary Govind Mohan** reviewed the security situation in Manipur on Monday, April 27, 2026, amid ongoing unrest and killings. The meeting addressed issues such as the withdrawal of **Central armed police forces (CAPFs)** for West Bengal elections, frequent disruptions and blockades by women groups, and new areas of conflict between Kuki and Naga communities.  **Around 36,000 security forces**, including Assam Rifles, are deployed in Manipur since 2023.

recent_articles.title: Weather tracker: Torrential rain in southern China leads to flooding fears | Extreme weather | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Widespread heavy rainfall** is impacting southern China, with **the Office of the State Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters** and the **Ministry of Emergency Management** urging preparedness for potential flooding.  Torrential rain is also forecast in Bangladesh, northern Myanmar, and parts of India, while central and northern India are experiencing extreme heat waves with temperatures exceeding 45°C. Heavy rainfall has caused damage in Nigeria, particularly in Jalingo, due to poor drainage infrastructure. Unseasonably cold weather is affecting western Canada, with daytime temperatures below freezing in Calgary, Edmonton, and Saskatoon.

recent_articles.title: NCB seizes 474 soap cases of heroin worth ₹11 crore in Manipur - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB)**, in collaboration with **the State police** and **Assam Rifles**, seized 474 soap cases of heroin worth ₹11 crore in Manipur's Churachandpur district.  During the operation on April 23rd, the joint team intercepted a vehicle suspected of carrying narcotics. The contraband weighed approximately 5.42 kg and is estimated to have an illicit market value of around ₹11 crore. Three individuals involved in the transportation of the drugs were arrested. **The NCB** stated that it has been intensifying its operations in Manipur due to the state's vulnerability to drug trafficking.

recent_articles.title: March to Manipur CM’s house foiled; 22 injured - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **More than 20 people** were injured in clashes between protesters and security personnel in Imphal, **Manipur**, on Saturday (April 25, 2026). **The Coordinating Committee on Manipur Integrity (COCOMI)**, a conglomerate of Meitei civil society organizations, organized the protest demanding the arrest of those involved in the April 7 bomb attack that killed two children.  **COCOMI** had previously announced a boycott of the ruling BJP and held a rally near the iconic Kangla Fort before meeting with the Chief Minister to submit a memorandum. The incident followed the death of three protesters in Bishnupur, which triggered the protest. In Ukhrul district, an armored vehicle from a paramilitary force rammed barricades set up by locals protesting against inaction against Kuki armed groups.

recent_articles.title: ‘Victim is Dalit, poor every time’: Rahul Gandhi demands probe into Ghazipur rape-murder - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, **Priyanka Gandhi Vadra**, and the **Congress party** are demanding a high-level investigation into the alleged rape and murder of a girl from the Vishwakarma community in Uttar Pradesh's Ghazipur district. **Gandhi** criticized the government for its inaction and demanded immediate justice, protection for the victim's family, and action against police officers involved.  He also questioned Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** and Chief Minister **Yogi Adityanath**, asking why their rule has made daughters unsafe.

recent_articles.title: Watch: Manipur sees little respite despite a change of guard under the BJP | The Hindu Editorial - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Home Ministry** and the **BJP** are calling for increased cooperation to quell tensions in the country. They suggest a more proactive role by the **Home Ministry** and an effort by the **BJP** to involve all political actors in easing the situation. The strategy also includes empowering security agencies to target hardline elements engaging in violence.

recent_articles.title: Manipur rights group opposes powers to lower-ranked police officers under UAPA - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Youth’s Forum for Protection of Human Rights (YFPHR)** has criticized a **Manipur government** notification implementing Section 43A of the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act, 1967. The YFPHR called for the withdrawal of the notification, arguing it could create fear and criminalize civilians during ongoing protests demanding justice for two minors killed in Bishnupur district.  The notification empowers lower-ranked law enforcement officers to act against unlawful activities, including arrests, searches, and seizures.

recent_articles.title: Election Commission, and not the BJP, seems to be fighting Trinamool in West Bengal, says Kapil Sibal - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kapil Sibal**, a senior Supreme Court lawyer and Rajya Sabha MP, criticized the **Election Commission of India (ECI)**'s actions in West Bengal ahead of the upcoming elections. He accused the **EC** and the **BJP** of working together to suppress the Trinamool Congress (TMC), alleging an "unconstitutional Emergency" and a disproportionate deployment of Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF).  Other opposition leaders, including **Arvind Kejriwal**, have also expressed concern over the situation.

recent_articles.title: Over 58,800 people displaced by ethnic violence since May 2023: Manipur govt - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Manipur's** State government confirmed that 58,821 people have been displaced due to ethnic violence since May 3, 2023. The information was revealed in response to an RTI filed by **Hareshwar Goshwami**, a Manipur Congress leader.  The **Home Department Secretariat** also reported that 217 deaths and injuries were recorded as of March 30, 2023, based on ex-gratia payments for next of kin.

recent_articles.title: Watch: Can Iran and the U.S. find middle ground? - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The next phase of peace talks between the **US** and **Iran** appears uncertain ahead of Wednesday's ceasefire deadline.  Meanwhile, fresh violence in **Manipur**, a powerful earthquake in **Japan**, and the deadliest mass shooting in **Louisiana** are also making headlines.

recent_articles.title: Five deaths, no arrests as fresh violence grips Manipur - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Since April 7th, **Manipur** has experienced five killings, including the deaths of two children. The **National Investigation Agency (NIA)** is investigating the April 7th attack on a family in Tronglaobi, Bishnupur, but roadblocks have hindered their progress.  The attacks have led to clashes between locals and security forces demanding arrests. **Meitei** civil society groups have accused **Kuki-Zo insurgent groups** of being behind the violence, while the Deputy Chief Minister of Manipur, **Losii Dikho**, believes these incidents could be an attempt to incite unrest.

recent_articles.title: Amid shutdown, Manipur group calls for BJP boycott - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **COCOMI**, a conglomerate of Meitei civil society organizations in Manipur, announced a boycott of the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** in the state following continued violence and a shutdown. The group demanded an explanation from Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh for failing to stop attacks on civilians.  The boycott was prompted by anger over the alleged failure of the BJP to prevent "proxy war" by armed groups against indigenous people, with Meitei women's groups and civil society organizations calling for a five-day shutdown. The **United Naga Council (UNC)** joined the Meitei groups in extending the shutdown to seven days following the killing of two Tangkhul Naga men allegedly by Kuki extremists.

recent_articles.title: Two killed in ambush on Manipur highway - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Suspected extremists** ambushed a convoy of civilian vehicles on National Highway 202 in Manipur's Ukhrul district, killing two Tangkhul Naga men. The attack occurred near Yaolen Kuki village and involved unidentified individuals firing upon six vehicles traveling towards Ukhrul from Imphal. **The Working Committee of Tangkhul Naga Long (TNL)** accused **Kuki armed groups** of being responsible for the ambush, while the **Kuki-Zo Council** denied involvement. The incident sparked renewed tension between the Tangkhul Naga and Kuki communities, with the TNL demanding a combing operation in Yaolen and adjoining Kuki villages.  The Chief Minister has registered a case at the Litan police station and requested the National Investigation Agency (NIA) to take over the investigation.

recent_articles.title: Law and order remain sensitive but under control: Manipur CM - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Y. Khemchand Singh**, Chief Minister of Manipur, stated that while the state's law and order remains sensitive, it is under control following a meeting with **Major General Gaurav Sharma**, IGAR (South).  The briefing reaffirmed that security forces are responding to disturbances with care and restraint.

recent_articles.title: Consolidated voters’ list of 9 States and 3 UTs that underwent SIR Phase II trimmed by 10.2% - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Election Commission of India** announced the results of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in nine states and three Union Territories. **Uttar Pradesh** recorded the highest net deletion of voters at 2.04 crore, followed by **West Bengal**, with a net deletion of 83.86 lakh. The SIR phase II identified 67 lakh deceased voters and 1.28 crore duplicate voters across these states and UTs.  The consolidated electoral rolls saw a reduction of 10.2%, bringing the number of active voters down to 45.81 crore.

recent_articles.title: Consolidated voters’ list of 12 States and UTs that underwent SIR Phase II trimmed by 10.2% - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Election Commission of India** announced the results of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, which saw a significant reduction in voter numbers across nine states and three Union Territories. **Uttar Pradesh** recorded the highest net deletion of voters at 2.04 crore, followed by West Bengal with 83.86 lakh.  The revision identified 67 lakh deceased voters and 1.28 crore duplicate voters for removal. The consolidated electoral rolls across these regions saw a reduction of 10.2%, bringing the number of active voters down to 45.81 crore.
